blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) have already been shown to match or exceed human experts in persuasion. While their persuasive capabilities hold promise for beneficial uses such as education and health communication, they can also be used to manipulate and misinform, making their evaluation a growing priority for developers and regulators. That evaluation, however, remains fragmented: studies differ in what they treat as persuasion, and broad claims often rest on narrow, situation-specific assessments. Automated methods, often modelled on human studies, offer a way to compare such assessments directly, as they can be run on the same models at scale and can include high-risk forms of persuasion that would be difficult or unethical to test on people.
In this study, we adapt nine published automated methods to a shared setup, run them on the same fifteen LLMs, and ask whether their rankings agree and why.
We find that the methods agree only weakly (mean Spearman ρ = 0.25 \rho=0.25 ).
Our analyses point to two contributing factors. Models that refuse some tasks but not others, directly or indirectly, lower agreement by about a quarter, and these refusals fall mostly on manipulation tasks. General capability also plays a part: most rational persuasion (non-manipulative) methods track it, whereas most manipulation methods do not. Together, these findings suggest that agreement depends more on the task a method sets than on how it scores persuasion, although this pattern is only indicative given the eight methods available for analysis.
More broadly, our results suggest that persuasion scores combine a model’s ability to persuade with its willingness to do so.
A single score is therefore informative about its own setting, but says little about a model’s persuasiveness across tasks.

blocks.en:
Persuasion is a cornerstone of our society, shaping the political landscape, economies, and interpersonal relationships.
In the digital age, persuasion has increasingly become a computational and data-driven process.
Now, with the advent of Large Language Models (LLMs), the landscape of influence is changing once again, combining the scale of mass communication with the personalisation of individual interactions.
As a powerful means of influencing beliefs, attitudes, and behaviour, LLMs can support beneficial applications, such as education, health communication, and public engagement.
At the same time, however, they may be misused to manipulate opinions, spread misinformation, or facilitate fraud and other harmful forms of influence.
blocks.zh:
劝导是我们社会的基石,塑造了政治格局,经济,人际关系.
在数字时代,说服越来越成为一个由计算和数据驱动的过程.
现在,随着"大语言模型"(LLMs)的出现,影响力的地貌再次发生变化,将大众传播的规模与个人互动的个性化结合起来.
作为影响信仰、态度和行为的有力手段,法学硕士课程可以支持有益的应用,如教育、卫生交流和公众参与。
但与此同时,它们可能被滥用于操纵意见、传播错误信息或为欺诈和其他有害影响形式提供便利。

blocks.en:
The International AI Safety Report identifies manipulation and influence operations as malicious-use risks of general-purpose AI ( Bengio et al. 2025 ; Bengio and others 2026 ) , and recent governance frameworks have begun to address them.
The EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice names harmful manipulation as one of the systemic risks that providers of the most capable models commit to assessing ( European Commission 2025 ) , and developers have added manipulation to the capabilities they evaluate before deployment ( Google DeepMind 2025 ) .
Addressing these risks, and meeting regulatory requirements, requires a clear definition of LLM persuasiveness and a way to measure it. Recent work has made progress on the definition ( Jones and Bergen 2026 ; Bozdag et al. 2026b ) , but its evaluation remains fragmented ( Dementaviciute and others 2026 ) . Studies differ in what they treat as persuasion, and broad claims about a model’s persuasiveness often rest on narrow, situation-specific tasks.

欧盟通用AI业务守则将有害的操纵列为最有能力的模型提供者承诺评估的系统性风险之一(欧盟委员会,2025年),开发者在部署前的评价能力(Google DeepMind,2025年)上增加了操纵.
应对这些风险并满足监管要求,需要明确界定LLM的说服力和衡量方法. 最近的工作在定义方面取得了进展(Jones和Bergen 2026;Bozdag等2026b.),但其评价仍然支离破碎(Dementaviciute等2026.). 研究的不同之处在于它们将什么视为说服,而对于一个模型的说服力的广泛主张往往取决于狭隘的、针对具体情况的任务。

blocks.en:
This study examines this fragmentation by comparing published LLM persuasion evaluation methods on the same models, asking whether they reach the same conclusions about which models are most persuasive, and what explains where they differ.
Human studies, the traditional approach, are costly to compare systematically and often infeasible in high-risk settings.
We therefore focus on automated evaluation methods, a rapidly growing area of research ( Dementaviciute and others 2026 ) , which can be run side by side on the same set of models at a scale that makes such a comparison possible. Our findings may nevertheless be relevant for human studies as well, since many automated methods adopt tasks, outcome measures and definitions of persuasive success from them ( Noels and others 2026 ; Bozdag et al. 2026b ) .

人类研究,即传统方法,对高风险环境进行系统比较,往往不可行,代价高昂。
因此,我们侧重于自动化评估方法,这是一个迅速增长的研究领域(Dementaviciute等2026年),可以在同一套模型上并肩运行,其规模使这种比较成为可能。 然而,我们的调查结果可能也与人类研究有关,因为许多自动化方法都采用了任务、结果计量和对其说服成功的定义(Noels等,2026;Bozdag等,2026b)。

blocks.en:
Because there is no gold standard for persuasiveness, we do not ask which method is right, but whether the methods agree. On its own, agreement would not prove that they measure persuasion, but reliable disagreement would show that they cannot all be measuring the same thing.
The methods produce scores on different scales, so we compare them by how they rank the fifteen models. Specifically, we address the following research questions:

这些方法在不同的尺度上产生分数,所以我们比较它们是如何排列出15个模型的. 具体而言,我们处理下列研究问题:

blocks.en: Statement of Contributions
blocks.zh: 捐款说明

blocks.en: To our knowledge, this paper presents the first comparison of existing automated methods for evaluating LLM persuasiveness on a common set of models. The closest study ranks six models across six manipulation environments built within a single framework ( Zaman and others 2026 ) , whereas we compare nine independently published methods, covering both rational persuasion and manipulation, on fifteen models. All results in this paper are new, and no earlier version of this work has been published or presented. Its contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,本文件首次比较了评价LLM对一套共同模型的说服力的现有自动化方法。 最接近的研究将六个模型排列在六个在单一框架(Zaman等2026年)内构建的操纵环境上,而我们比较了九个独立公布的方法,包括理性说服和操纵,共15个模型. 本文中的所有成果都是新的,没有出版或介绍这一作品的更早版本. 其贡献如下:

blocks.en: • A shared harness. We adapted nine published persuasion evaluation methods to one shared setup and ran them on the same fifteen LLMs. The main changes to the original studies are documented in Appendix B , and the code will be released as open source. 1 1 1 https://github.com/aida-ugent/llm-persuasion-eval-comparison • A test of agreement. We show that the methods, as adapted, agree only weakly on how they rank the models (mean Spearman ρ = 0.25 \rho=0.25 over the eight reliable methods), and that sampling noise is unlikely to explain this. Figure 1 gives a first view: across the nine methods, seven different models come first. • Sources of the disagreement. Our results indicatively point to two sources. The first is refusals: models that explicitly refuse some tasks but not others lower the agreement by about a quarter. The second is the type of task (rational persuasion or manipulation), which seems to matter more than how a method scores persuasion: rational persuasion evaluation methods agree moderately with one another, whereas manipulation evaluation methods agree neither with the rational ones nor with each other. The two sources are linked, as the more capable models often refuse the manipulative tasks. • A capability check. Following Ren et al. (2024) , we measure how much each ranking reflects general capability. Most rational persuasion methods track it, two of the three manipulative methods do not. • Recommendations. We discuss what these findings mean where persuasion results inform decisions about a model’s release, and we recommend how such results should be reported.

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1 LLM Persuasiveness Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.1 LLM(低压) 说服力评价

blocks.en: Persuasion is a broad term with varying definitions across literature. Following O’Keefe (2015) and the functional operationalisation for LLMs by Jones and Bergen (2026) , we define persuasion as an intentional effort to influence another party’s opinions, beliefs, or behaviour by appealing to their cognitive decision-making processes through communication. As an umbrella term, persuasion covers both rational persuasion , which openly engages the other party’s reasoning through arguments and evidence, and manipulation , which covertly exploits it, for example through deception (inducing false beliefs) ( Jones and Bergen 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 劝说是一个广义的术语,不同文献的定义各不相同. 在O-Keefe(2015年)和琼斯和卑尔根对LLMS的功能操作(2026年)之后,我们把说服定义为通过沟通吸引他人认知决策进程来影响另一方观点、信仰或行为的蓄意努力。 作为总括术语,劝导既包括理性劝导(通过论据和证据公开介入对方的推理),也包括操纵(通过欺骗(诱发虚假信仰))(琼斯和卑尔根2026年)等隐蔽利用.

blocks.en: As LLM capabilities have grown, studies with human participants have found them to match or exceed human persuaders in several settings ( Durmus et al. 2024 ; Salvi et al. 2025 ; Bai et al. 2025 ; Hackenburg et al. 2026 ) . Several surveys now map this work, covering taxonomies of computational persuasion ( Bozdag et al. 2026b ) , the construct and its risks ( Jones and Bergen 2026 ) , findings from human studies ( Noels and others 2026 ) , and automated evaluation methods ( Dementaviciute and others 2026 ) . The last of these shows how widely automated evaluation methods vary. The evaluated model may be tasked to write a single persuasive text, converse with a simulated persuadee, usually another LLM, or argue in a multi-agent debate. Its task ranges from honest advocacy on social issues to deceiving a persuadee into accepting a false claim. Its score may come from an LLM-judge, a model trained on human judgements, the persuadee’s self-reported belief, a rule applied to the conversation (such as whether a payment was made), or the correct answers of a dataset. Other evaluations measure not whether a model succeeds but whether it attempts persuasion at all, finding that models differ widely in this and often attempt persuasion on harmful topics they would refuse to assist with directly ( Kowal et al. 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 随着LLM能力的增长,与人类参与者的研究发现它们在几种环境下可以匹配或超过人类的说服者(Durmus等. 2024; Salvi等编. 2025; Bai等人著. 2025; Hackenburg等2026 (中文(简体) ). 目前,一些调查绘制了这项工作的地图,包括计算说服的分类(Bozdag等人,2026年b),构造及其风险(Jones和Bergen,2026年),人类研究的结果(Noels等人,2026年),以及自动化评价方法(Dementaviciute等人,2026年)。 其中最后一个显示自动化评价方法的差别有多大。 被评价的模型可能的任务是写出一个单一的有说服力的文本,与一个模拟的劝说(通常为另一个LLM)交汇,或者在多代理辩论中争论. 其任务从诚实地宣传社会问题到欺骗说服接受虚假主张。 其得分可能来自LLM法官、接受过人类判断培训的模型、劝导者自报的信念、适用于对话的规则(如是否付款)或数据集的正确答案。 其他评价不是衡量一个模型是否成功,而是衡量它是否试图说服,发现模型在这方面差别很大,往往试图说服它们拒绝直接协助的有害主题(Kowal等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Despite these differences, the results are often read as measures of a single capability, persuasiveness. Developers report several such evaluations side by side under persuasion ( Phuong et al. 2024 ; OpenAI 2024 ) , and inevitably short paper titles often fail to reveal potentially consequential differences in how a particular evaluation method conceptualizes persuasiveness ( Pauli and others 2025 ; Bozdag et al. 2026a ; Ju et al. 2025 ; Liu et al. 2025 ) . Human validation cannot settle whether this reading is justified. It covers only some methods, with strong agreement for those that score arguments but mixed agreement for those that measure changes in belief or behaviour ( Dementaviciute and others 2026 ) , and the results of human studies themselves appear to depend on the model, the conversation design, and the domain ( Hölbling et al. 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 尽管存在这些差异,结果往往被理解为一个单一能力、说服力的衡量标准。 开发者在说服下并肩报告一些此类评价(Phuong等人,2024;OpenAI 2024),而且不可避免地短纸标题往往无法揭示特定评价方法如何概念化说服力的潜在后果差异(Pauli等) 2025; Bozdag等编. 2026a; Ju等. 2025; 刘等. 2025). 人类验证不能解决这种解读是否合理. 它只涵盖一些方法,对于得分论者有强烈的认同,而对于衡量信仰或行为变化者(Dementaviciute等2026年)则有褒贬不一的认同,而人类研究成果本身似乎取决于模型,对话设计,以及域名(Hölbling等2025年).

blocks.en: 2.2 Evaluating the Evaluations
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 评价

blocks.en: The question of whether different evaluations agree is not new to LLM benchmarking. Perlitz et al. (2025) formalise benchmark agreement testing and show that measured agreement depends on which and how many models are compared, and on whether the whole ranking or only the top is considered. Desai et al. (2026) adapt convergent and discriminant validity to 56 capability and safety benchmarks and find that safety benchmarks meant to measure the same concept often agree only weakly.
blocks.zh: 不同评价是否同意的问题,对于衡量LLM标准并不新鲜。 Perlitz等人(2025年)将基准协议测试正规化,并显示所计量的协议取决于哪些模型和多少模型进行比较,以及是否考虑整个排名还是仅考虑上位. Desai等人(2026年)根据56项能力和安全基准调整了趋同和歧视性的有效性,并发现旨在衡量同一概念的安全基准往往只得到微弱的同意。

blocks.en: Ren et al. (2024) examine a further question: whether a score tracks anything beyond general capability. Many safety benchmarks appear to track capability closely, so capability gains can pass as safety gains. While some link to capability is expected for persuasion, its exact nature remains unclear. In a large-scale human study, the persuasive advantage of larger models mostly disappeared once basic task completion, such as staying on topic, was accounted for ( Hackenburg et al. 2025 ) . A persuasion score may therefore partly reflect general capability, meaning two methods may agree simply because they both track it.
blocks.zh: Ren等(2024年)考察了另一个问题:一个分数跟踪是否超出一般能力. 许多安全基准似乎都密切跟踪能力,因此能力增益可以随着安全增益而通过。 虽然期望与能力有某种联系,但其确切性质仍不清楚。 在一项大规模的人类研究中,大型模型的说服力优势大多在基本任务完成后就消失了,例如停留在专题上(Hackenburg等2025年). 因此,说服分数可能部分反映一般能力,也就是说,两种方法可能都同意,因为它们都跟踪。

blocks.en: For persuasion, the closest prior work is a study of LLM manipulation that tests six models in six environments built within a single framework ( Zaman and others 2026 ) . It found that which models manipulate most often in one environment says little about which do so in another, as their rankings barely correlate across environments (mean Spearman ρ = 0.055 \rho=0.055 ), and concludes that models have no stable propensity to manipulate.
blocks.zh: 为了说服,前作中最接近的作品是对LLM操控的研究,该研究在一个单一框架(Zaman等2026年)内所构建的6个环境中测试了6个模型. 它发现,在一个环境中最常操纵的模型很少说出在另一个环境中操纵的模型,因为它们的排名在环境中几乎没有关联(Mean Spearman ^ = 0.055\rho= 0.055),并得出结论,模型没有稳定的操纵倾向.

blocks.en: 3 Study Design
blocks.zh: 3 研究设计

blocks.en: To compare nine published persuasion evaluation methods, we adapted each to a shared setup, with the same persuadee and judge wherever these roles are needed, and ran all of them on the same fifteen LLMs.
blocks.zh: 为了比较9个已公布的说服评价方法,我们各自改用一个共用的机构,在需要这些作用的地方,都采用同样的说服和判断方法,并在同样的15个法学硕士课程上管理所有这些方法。

blocks.en: 3.1 Evaluation Methods
blocks.zh: 3.1 评价方法

blocks.en:
Applying these criteria left nine methods, with code availability checked in August 2026.
Table 1 summarises the selected methods as run in this study. A more detailed description can be found in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
应用这些标准留下了9个方法,2026年8月检查了代码的可用性.
表1概述了本研究中采用的某些方法。 详见附录A。

blocks.en: To ensure comparability across methods, several changes to the original setups were required. All the adaptations are explained in detail and justified in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 为确保各种方法之间的可比性,需要对最初的设置进行若干修改。 附录B详细解释了所有修改,并说明理由。

blocks.en: Table 1: The nine compared methods, with their short names in this paper and the study each was adapted from. Descriptions refer to the methods as adapted in this study. Setup : the items every model saw and the number of rounds per interaction, a round being one message from the evaluated model and the persuadee’s reply (in Mislead Debate , one message from each of the three agents).
blocks.zh: 表1:比较的九种方法,以及本文中的简称和各项研究都改编自此。 说明是指本研究中修改的方法. 设定:每个模型看到的项目和每次互动的回合数,一回合是评价模型发出的信息和劝告者的答复(在Mislead Conversation中,三个代理人各发出一个信息)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluated Models
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价的模式

blocks.en:
We evaluated fifteen models across different model families, parameter counts, release dates, and countries of origin (China, France, South Korea, and the United States; Table 2 ).
Ten open-weight models were run locally. The remaining five (two closed-weight, three open-weight) were accessed through their providers’ APIs.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了不同模范家庭、参数计算、释放日期和原籍国的15个模型(中国、法国、韩国和美国;表2)。
当地运行了10个开放重量型号. 其余5个(两个封闭式重量,三个开放式重量)通过供应商的API访问。

blocks.en: The models were selected to span a wide range of capability, and to give the comparison enough statistical power. Perlitz et al. (2025) advise at least ten models when estimating agreement between benchmarks, since correlations from smaller sets vary substantially with which models are sampled, and a range of performance levels. With fifteen models, the standard error of a rank correlation is approximately 0.27 when the true correlation is near zero. This is sufficient to distinguish strong agreement from little or no agreement. The set includes models of similar capability, such as Gemma-3-27B and Qwen3-32B , and models far apart, such as Llama-3.2-3B and GPT-5.6-Sol , so the methods are tested on both small and large differences.
blocks.zh: 选择这些模型是为了涵盖广泛的能力,并给予充分的统计能力。 Perlitz等人(2025年)在估计基准之间的一致时,至少为10个模型提供了建议,因为较小的一组模型的关联性差别很大,与哪些模型进行抽样,以及一系列性能水平。 有了15个模型,当真实的关联性接近于零时,一个等级关联的标准错误约为0.27. 这足以将强有力的协议与很少或没有的协议区分开来。 该集包括了类似能力的模型,如Gemma-3-27B和Qune3-32B等,以及相去相去甚远的模型,如Llama-3.2-3B和GPT-5.6-Sol等,因此这些方法在大小差异上都进行了测试.

blocks.en: Table 2: The fifteen evaluated models. Reas. (reasoning): – not reasoning-capable, off = not used, on = provider’s default. *Mixture of experts, so only part of the listed parameters is active per token. The five API models are the frontier models.
blocks.zh: 表2:15个评价模型。 Reas.(推理): – 无法推理,关闭=没有使用,在=提供者的默认上. * 专家的混合,所以只列出部分参数为每个符号活性. 五个API模型是前沿模型.

blocks.en: 3.3 Analysis Plan
blocks.zh: 3.3 分析计划

blocks.en:
Each method scores the models in its own units, so we compare the methods by how they rank the fifteen models.
The scores form a 9 × 15 9\times 15 matrix, where each cell is a model’s mean over a method’s sampling units: the items drawn for it, such as the 100 claims of Subjective Opinion or the 50 codewords of MakeMeSay .
All confidence intervals for agreement and reliability come from resampling these units.
In most methods each unit produces one output. A few run the same item through several fixed conditions, such as the eleven strategies of False Claim , and there the item is the unit and all its outputs are resampled together. Reduce Meat is the reverse: each conversation is a unit, resampled within its four fixed conditions (Table 7 lists the unit of every method).
blocks.zh:
每种方法在自己的单位里对模型进行评分,所以我们比较这些方法是如何对15个模型进行排序的.
得分构成一个9×15 9\times 15矩阵,其中每个单元格是一个模型相对于一个方法的采样单位的平均值:为其取出的物品,如100个主观见解主张或MakeMeSay的50个密码词.
同意和可靠性的所有信任间隔都来自这些单元的再取样。
在大多数方法中,每个单元都产生一个输出. 少数公司通过若干固定条件运行同一项目,如11项“虚假索赔战略”,项目就是单元,其所有产出都重印在一起。 减少 肉是倒数:每次对话都是一个单元,在其四个固定条件下重印(表7列出了每种方法的单位).

blocks.en: RQ1: Do the Methods Agree?
blocks.zh: RQ1:方法是否一致?

blocks.en: For each of the 36 method pairs we compute Spearman’s ρ \rho and Kendall’s τ b \tau_{b} and summarise them by the Fisher- z z mean, with a bootstrap interval over sampling units and a jackknife over models. We also report each method’s ρ \rho with the mean ranking of the other eight (leave-one-out).
blocks.zh: 对于36个方法对,我们计算Spearman 的 ^\rho 和 Kendall 的 ^ b\tau_{b } 并用 Fisher-z 的 z 表示来概括它们,在取样单元上有一个靴子间隔,在模型上有一个小刀。 我们还以其他八种方法的中位数(留一出)来报告每种方法的 $\rho 。

blocks.en: A low correlation can reflect different constructs or measurement noise. To separate the two, we report each method’s split-half reliability and, as an upper bound on agreement, the disattenuated correlation ( Spearman 1904 ) , ρ / r a ​ r b \rho/\sqrt{r_{a}r_{b}} , which estimates how closely two methods would agree without measurement noise. We use the lower end of each reliability interval, which gives the largest correction, and cap the result at 1. If the disagreement were mainly noise, this correction would raise the agreement substantially. We read the corrected value against 0.7, a common reference for convergent validity between measures of one construct ( Carlson and Herdman 2012 ) .
blocks.zh: 低相关性可以反映不同的构造或测量噪声. 为了区分这两种方法,我们报告每种方法的半分可靠性,并作为协议的上限,报告断裂的关联性(Spireman 1904), ρ/r a r b\rho/\ sqrt{r_{a}r_{b}}, 估计两种方法在没有测量噪音的情况下会如何接近一致。 我们使用每个可靠性间隔的下端,这给出了最大的校正,结果上限为1. 如果分歧主要是噪音,这一更正将大大增加协议。 我们阅读了0.7的校正值,这是一种结构的计量方法(卡尔森和赫德曼,2012年)之间趋同有效性的共同参考。

blocks.en: RQ1 analysis is reported for the reliable methods (split-half ≥ 0.80 \geq 0.80 ) and for all nine, the rest of RQ2 and RQ3 for the reliable ones only.
blocks.zh: 报告关于可靠方法的RQ1分析(一半为0.80\geq 0.80),关于所有9个方法,其余的RQ2和RQ3只为可靠方法。

blocks.en: RQ2: What Explains It?
blocks.zh: RQ2:什么解释?

blocks.en: We examine three factors that may affect how much the methods agree: (1) refusals, (2) differences in the tasks the methods set and how they measure persuasion, and (3) general capability, addressed under RQ3.
blocks.zh: 我们审查了可能影响方法一致程度的三个因素:(1) 拒绝;(2) 确定的任务和如何衡量说服力的不同;和(3) 一般性能力,在RQ3之下处理。

blocks.en:
There is no common protocol for dealing with refusals in persuasion evaluation. Five of the seven academic studies we adapted do not mention them, one counts them as failed generations ( Bozdag et al. 2026a ) , and one measures refusal as a separate safety outcome ( Liu et al. 2025 ) .
We score a refused attempt as zero, the value of an attempt with no persuasive effect. A model that refuses on some methods but not others can therefore rank lower on those methods because it declined the task, not because it persuaded less well.
To measure how much this lowers agreement, we recompute every ranking with refused or empty attempts excluded and compare the mean pairwise ρ \rho under the two rules.
Scoring a refusal as zero describes the model as deployed, while excluding refusals describes the model when it is willing to do the task.
The interval on the difference comes from a paired bootstrap: over the same 500 resamples under both rules.
Under exclusion, a cell whose attempts were all refused drops out of the ranking, and we recompute each method’s reliability, as fewer items remain.
blocks.zh:
处理劝说评价中的拒绝问题没有共同的协议。 我们所改编的7个学术研究中有5个没有提及它们,1个将它们算作失败的几代人(Bozdag等2026a),1个将拒绝作为单独的安全结果的措施(刘等2025年)。
我们的一次被拒绝的尝试得分为零,一次尝试的价值没有说服力的效果. 因此,拒绝某些方法而拒绝其他方法的模型在这些方法上排名较低,因为它拒绝了任务,而不是因为它说服力较低。
为了衡量这在多大程度上降低了协议,我们重新计算每个被排除的拒绝尝试或空尝试的排名,并比较两个规则下的平均对等 $\rho 。
将拒绝划为0描述为已部署的模式,而排除拒绝则描述该模式是否愿意完成任务.
相差相差的间隔取自一对靴子:在两条规则下,同一500个复标上.
在排除的情况下,一个被全部拒绝的单元格退出了排名,我们重新计算每种方法的可靠性,因为留下的物品较少。

blocks.en: The second factor is the tasks the methods set and how they measure persuasion. With only eight reliable methods, this part is exploratory. We explored groupings of the methods along eighteen axes. Twelve describe how a method measures or is designed, such as what the score stands for, what produces it, and whether a persuadee is in the loop. Six describe the task, for example its goal, whether it asks for rational persuasion or manipulation, and what the persuadee gives up by yielding (Table 8 ).
blocks.zh: 第二个因素是确定的方法和如何衡量说服力。 只有八种可靠的方法,这一部分是探索性的。 我们探索了按18个轴线划分的方法。 十二描述一种方法的衡量方法或设计方法,如分数代表什么,产生什么,以及劝告者是否在循环中. 六描述了任务,例如其目标,无论是要求合理说服还是操纵,以及劝告者通过屈服放弃什么(表8)。

blocks.en:
For each axis we compare the mean ρ \rho between methods that share a label with the mean ρ \rho between methods that do not, and call the difference the gap.
A permutation test over all relabellings of the reliable methods with the same group sizes shows whether the grouping separates the methods better than a random split would.
Since the best of eighteen groupings could look good by chance, we adjust each p p with the Westfall–Young procedure ( Westfall and Young 1993 ) , which applies every shuffle to all eighteen axes at once and so allows for their overlap.
Finally, to see whether capability or refusals explain the groupings, we repeat the analysis with general capability removed from each ranking and with refused or empty attempts excluded.
blocks.zh:
对于每个轴,我们比较了使用标签的方法和不使用标签的方法之间的平均为 $ \rho 的方法,并称差值。
对所有具有相同组大小的可靠方法的再贴标签进行穿透测试,显示分组是否将方法分开,优于随机分拆。
由于18个组合中最好的组合可以偶然看好,因此我们根据Westfall–Young程序(Westfall and Young 1993)来调整每个p,该程序将每次洗牌一次适用于所有18个轴线,从而允许它们重叠。
最后,为了了解能力或拒绝是否解释这些类别,我们重复分析,从每个排名中取消一般能力,排除拒绝或空洞的尝试。

blocks.en: RQ3: Do the Methods Agree on Anything Beyond Capability?
blocks.zh: RQ3:方法是否就超出能力范围的事项达成一致?

blocks.en: Since persuasion arguably requires general capability, we expect each method’s ranking to correlate positively with a capability score. Following Ren et al. (2024) , who found that many safety benchmarks closely track general capability, we ask how strongly each method tracks it and whether the methods still agree once it is removed, which would point to a shared construct beyond capability.
blocks.zh: 说服需要一般能力, Ren等人(2024年)发现,许多安全基准密切跟踪一般能力,我们问,每一种方法都在多大程度上追踪到一般能力,这些方法一旦被移除,是否仍然同意,这将表明一种超越能力的共同结构。

blocks.en:
No public leaderboard covers all fifteen models, so we run two standard benchmarks on every model with the lm-evaluation-harness ( Gao et al. 2024 ) : MMLU-Pro ( Wang et al. 2024 ) , a knowledge and reasoning test (300 questions), and IFEval ( Zhou et al. 2023 ) , an instruction-following test (all 541 prompts). We standardise the two accuracies across the models and average them into a capability score C C (Table 10 ).
For each method we report its Spearman correlation with C C and with each benchmark alone (Table 6 ). We then recompute every RQ1 pairwise correlation among the reliable methods after removing from each ranking the part that capability predicts (the partial correlation ρ m ​ m ′ ⋅ C \rho_{mm^{\prime}\cdot C} ).
Since removing any variable from fifteen rankings shifts the correlations somewhat, we compare the change for C C with a placebo, the same computation with 2,000 random orderings of the models in place of C C , both for the mean agreement and for each pair of methods.
blocks.zh:
没有公共领导板覆盖所有15个模型,因此我们用lm-valuation-harness(高出等2024年)对每个模型进行两个标准基准: MMLU-Pro(王出等2024年),知识和推理测试(300个问题),IFEval(周出等2023年),指令跟踪测试(全部541个提示). 我们把两个模型的分数标准化,并将其平均为能力分C(表10)。
就每一种方法而言,我们报告Spearman与C和每个基准的相互关系(表6)。 然后,我们从每个排序中去掉能力预测的部分(部分相关性为 ^ m → C\rho_{mm^{\prime}\cdot C})后,重新计算可靠方法之间的每个RQ1对等关联。
由于从15个排名中移除任何变量会在一定程度上转移相关性,我们把C C的改变与安慰剂进行比较,同样的计算方式是2000个随机订购的模型取代C ,既是为了平均协议,也是为了每对方法。

blocks.en: 3.4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.4 实验设置

blocks.en: The following settings apply to every run.
blocks.zh: 以下设置适用于每次运行 。

blocks.en:
Seven of the nine methods require an LLM to play a simulated persuadee, and three require an LLM-judge. For comparability across methods, we pin a single persuadee, GPT-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 , and a single judge, GPT-4o-2024-11-20 , wherever either role is needed.
Both are dated snapshots, and neither is an evaluated model, so no model persuades or judges itself. GPT-4o is a common judge in persuasion studies. The persuadee is a cheaper non-reasoning model, since it runs on every item of seven methods. Both choices are tested with a second judge and a second persuadee (Section 3.7 ).
blocks.zh:
9个方法中的7个需要LLM来发挥模拟的说服力,3个需要LLM法官. 对于不同方法的可比性,我们给一个单一的劝说,GPT-4.1-mini-2025-04-14,以及一个单一的法官,GPT-4o-2024-11-20,无论需要哪个角色。
两者都是有日期的快照,也都不是被评价的模型,因此没有模型说服或判断自己. GPT-4o是说服研究中常见的法官. 劝告是一种便宜的非理性模式,因为它贯穿于七种方法的每一个项目上. 这两种选择都由第二名法官和第二名说服者检验(第3.7节)。

blocks.en: We used each original study’s temperatures, so they differ between methods as they do between the studies. Where a study set none, pinned agents ran at 0 and evaluated models at their default, as deployed. The few exceptions are listed in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们用的是每一个原始研究的温度, 所以它们和研究的温度不同。 如果一项研究设置为零,则被钉住的毒剂运行在0并按部署的模型默认值进行评估。 附录B列出了少数例外情况。

blocks.en: Eight of the selected models are reasoning-capable. Reasoning was off for three of them and left on for the other five (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 所选模型中有8个具有推理能力. 其中3人放弃了理由,其余5人放弃了理由(表2)。

blocks.en: The same seed was used for sampling across all fifteen models, so every model within a method saw the same items, claims, scenarios or codewords.
blocks.zh: 同样的种子被用于所有15个模型的取样,因此一种方法中的每一个模型都看到了相同的项目,索赔,情景或代号.

blocks.en: 3.5 Sample Sizes
blocks.zh: 3.5 样本大小

blocks.en:
To find the required sample size, each method was first run on five models at twenty sampling units: three spanning the capability range ( Llama-3.2-3B , GPT-OSS-120B , GPT-5.6-Sol ) and one close pair ( Gemma-3-27B , Qwen3-32B ), since separating similar models is the harder task. From this run we estimated the variance between models, s b 2 s^{2}_{b} , and within a model over its sampling units, s w 2 s^{2}_{w} , and chose the number of units n n so that the reliability of a model’s mean, s b 2 / ( s b 2 + s w 2 / n ) s^{2}_{b}/(s^{2}_{b}+s^{2}_{w}/n) , reaches 0.90. Reliability caps the correlation two methods can show, so this target keeps disagreement interpretable.
This is a planning target, and the observed split-half reliability at the final n n is judged against the conventional 0.80 in Results.
Because s b 2 s^{2}_{b} was only estimated on five, n n was multiplied by 1.5 where the budget allowed. Where the data or budget did not allow this n n , the method was kept and its reliability is reported with the results.
blocks.zh:
为了找到所需的样本尺寸,每种方法在20个采样单元中首先运行在5个模型上:3个跨能力范围(Llama-3.2-3B,GPT-OSS-120B,GPT-5.6-Sol)和1个近对(Gemma-3-27B,Qune3-32B),因为分离类似模型是更难的任务. 从这次运行中,我们估计了模型(s b 2 s^{2 s}_{2 s}_{b})和在模型中超过其采样单元(s w 2 s^{2 s}_{2 s}_{w}w})的相差,并选择了单位n的单位数,使模型的平均值(s b 2. / (s b 2. + s w 2. n) s^{2 s}_{2 s}_{2 s}_{w}/n)达到0.90. 可靠性封顶了两种相关方法可以显示,因此这个目标保持了分歧的解释性.
这是一个规划目标,在最后n时观察到的半分可靠性与常规的0.80 " 结果 " 相比较。
因为Sb 2 s-^{2}_{b}只估计到5个,n乘以预算允许的1.5. 如果数据或预算不允许这一n n ,则保留该方法,并随结果报告其可靠性。

blocks.en: 3.6 Unscored Attempts
blocks.zh: 3.6 无记分尝试

blocks.en:
Not every LLM persuasion attempt produces a score. The model may refuse the task, which we detect by the provider’s refusal signal, a list of refusal phrases checked at the start of each of its turns (a match ends the conversation), or a decline written in prose in its first turn; it may return an empty response; or it may produce content that the method cannot read (prose where JSON was required, or a judge reply that cannot be parsed). In the main results, the first two cases are scored as zero, the value of an attempt with no persuasive effect, and the third is excluded, since it reflects format compliance or an instrument failure rather than persuasiveness.
The agreement analysis is also reported with all three kinds excluded, which we call the exclusion rule.
Models can also refuse indirectly, for example by correcting a false claim instead of supporting it. Such refusals take a different form in each task and cannot be detected consistently, so they are scored like any other attempt, which usually means no persuasive effect, as for a direct refusal. We look at them in more detail for False Claim , where they are frequent and clearly defined, since a paragraph either supports the false claim or does not (RQ2).
blocks.zh:
不是每次LLM说服都会产生分数. 模式可能拒绝任务,我们通过提供者的拒绝信号、每次回合开始时检查的拒绝短语清单(匹配结束对话),或第一次回合时写作的流言;它可能返回空回;或它可能产生无法读取的内容(需要JSON的地方,或法官的答复不能解析). 在主要结果中,前两个案例被评为零,尝试的价值没有说服力,第三个案例被排除在外,因为它反映了格式遵守或仪器故障而不是说服力.
还报告协定分析,不包括所有三类,我们称之为排除规则。
模型也可以间接拒绝,例如通过纠正虚假的主张而不是支持. 这种拒绝在每项任务中都采取不同的形式,无法一致地被检测出,因此被评分与其他任何尝试一样,这通常意味着没有直接拒绝的说服力. 我们更详细地看待这些错误索赔,因为这些索赔是频繁和明确界定的,因为有一段要么支持虚假索赔,要么不支持(RQ2)。

blocks.en: 3.7 Reliability and Robustness Checks
blocks.zh: 3.7 可靠性和自强性检查

blocks.en: Seven checks help us to separate the effect of the evaluated model from measurement noise and from our own methodological choices. Replicates: the first 20% of items in every cell were run twice, giving run-to-run reliability. Second judge: Rationale , Benign Request and MakeMeSay were rejudged by claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 at its default temperature, with each Rationale pair shown in both orders to cancel position bias ( Norman et al. 2026 ) . We report Cohen’s κ \kappa (quadratic-weighted for Benign Request ) and the rank correlation between the two rankings. Second persuadee: two methods ( Subjective Opinion , Benign Request ) were rerun on twenty items with the same Claude model as persuadee, and the rankings compared with the main run. Temperature: one method ( Subjective Opinion ) was rerun at temperature 0 on the ten local models. Unscored attempts : beside the alternative rule above, RQ1 is recomputed without the cells in which more than a quarter of the items were refused or unreadable. Human validation: we compare the pinned judge and the source paper’s judge ( GPT-4-turbo-2024-04-09 ) with the 212 human verdicts released for Rationale , the only judged method to release them. Reporting choices: False Claim pools eleven strategies and Mislead Debate three datasets, so we also rank the models under each one separately and compare with the pooled ranking. Since length partly predicts the human judgements behind the Rewrite Text scorer ( Pauli and others 2025 ) , we recompute its ranking with the effect of rewrite length, relative to the source, removed. Split-half reliability : 100 random splits of each method’s own items, Spearman–Brown corrected (Table 3 ).

blocks.en: Before comparing the methods, we ask whether each is a stable instrument on its own. Eight of the nine are: their split-half reliabilities lie between 0.82 and 0.99 (Table 3 ), and run-to-run correlations are 0.64 to 0.99. These eight form the reliable set analysed below. Mislead Debate falls short at 0.74 [0.65, 0.88], with a run-to-run correlation of only 0.43. Much of this appears to stem from the 512-token limit per debate message in our setup, which is tighter than the original’s. Without the limit, regenerated answers are more reliable (0.93) and rank the models quite differently ( ρ = 0.21 \rho=0.21 with our ranking). We therefore treat this method’s ranking with caution and leave it out of RQ2 and RQ3. Reduce Meat is reliable as a pooled score (0.82 [0.72, 0.92]), but its two personas rank the models differently ( ρ = − 0.30 \rho=-0.30 between them). False Claim ’s eleven strategies each rank the models much as the pooled score does ( ρ \rho 0.64 to 0.95), as do Mislead Debate ’s three datasets (0.66 to 0.80), and removing the effect of rewrite length barely changes the Rewrite Text ranking ( ρ = 0.93 \rho=0.93 ).

Scored only on the paragraphs that support the false claim, the method ranks the models very differently: the models that decline most appear to persuade best when they do try ( GPT-5.6-Sol 91%, against a median of 63%), and the method’s mean agreement with the other reliable methods rises from − 0.26 -0.26 to 0.38. blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
The methods agree only weakly on how they rank the fifteen models, and sampling noise is unlikely to explain this (RQ1).
The methods seem to measure different aspects of persuasion rather than a single capability, so a high score on one task does not guarantee a high score on another, especially across rational persuasion and manipulation.
They agree mostly on the smaller models, which they place near the bottom, but not on how to order the more capable ones.
This matters because safety frameworks and regulation are mainly concerned with the most capable models ( Google DeepMind 2025 ; European Commission 2025 ) , and for these the choice of evaluation method may largely determine the ranking.
blocks.zh:
有关方法对这15个模型的排名只达成了微弱的一致,取样噪音不太可能解释这一点(RQ1)。
这些方法似乎衡量说服的不同方面而不是单一的能力,因此一项任务的高分并不能保证另一项任务的高分,特别是在理性的说服和操纵中.
他们大多同意较小的模型,放在最下方,但不同意如何订购更有能力的模型。
这一点很重要,因为安全框架和监管主要涉及最有能力的模型(Google DeepMind 2025;欧盟委员会2025),对这些模型,选择评价方法可能在很大程度上决定排名。

blocks.en:
Two main groups of methods arise, one for rational persuasion and one for manipulation, although with only eight methods this pattern is indicative (RQ2). The rational persuasion methods agree with each other, whereas the manipulative methods agree neither with them nor with one another, consistent with Zaman and others (2026) .
The same model can therefore rank very differently on the two types of task: Claude-Fable-5.1 is among the top two models on four of the five rational persuasion methods, but among the bottom two on all three reliable manipulative ones.
blocks.zh:
出现两种主要方法,一种是理性说服方法,另一种是操纵方法,尽管这种模式只有八种方法是指示性的(RQ2)。 理性的说服方法彼此一致,而操纵方法则既不认同,也不认同,与扎曼等(2026)一致.
因此,在两类任务上,同一模式的排名可能非常不同: Claude-Fable-5.1是五种理性说服方法中的四种,但在所有三种可靠操纵方法中属于后二.

blocks.en:
Most methods rank the more capable models higher (RQ3). This is not a flaw in itself, since persuasiveness can be expected to grow with capability, but it raises the question of how much a method says about persuasion as distinct from general capability. Subjective Opinion , for example, ranks the models more like the capability score than like any other persuasion method.
This is similar to what Ren et al. (2024) found for many safety benchmarks and consistent with Hackenburg et al. (2025) , who found that the persuasive advantage of larger models largely disappears once researchers adjust for basic task completion (such as coherence and staying on topic).
Correcting for capability changed which methods agree, not only how much, so part of the agreement we observe is agreement about capability.
blocks.zh:
大多数方法将能力较强的模型排列得更高(RQ3). 这本身并不是一个缺陷,因为预期说服力会随着能力而增长,但它提出了一个问题,即一种方法对说服力表示多少有别于一般能力。 例如,主观观点将模型排入比其他说服方法更像能力分数。
这与Ren等人相似. (2024)发现许多安全基准,并与Hackenburg等人(2025)一致,后者发现,当研究人员调整基本任务完成(如一致性和坚持主题)后,较大模型的说服力优势基本消失.
对能力的纠正改变了哪些方法是一致的,而不仅仅是多少,因此,我们所看到的协议的一部分是关于能力的一致。

blocks.en:
Together, these results point to a distinction between ability and willingness to persuade.
Because every method instructs the model to persuade, its score combines the model’s ability to persuade when it tries with its willingness to try, and both differ from its tendency to persuade without being asked ( Kowal et al. 2025 ; Potter et al. 2024 ) .
Rational persuasion tasks are rarely refused, so their scores mostly reflect ability, which largely follows general capability, and these methods agree with one another. Manipulation tasks are declined, directly or indirectly, by some of the more capable models, so their scores also reflect willingness, and because models differ in which tasks they decline, these methods agree with neither the rational ones nor each other.
Scored only on the attempts in which the model argued as asked, the manipulative method False Claim ranks the models by capability and agrees with the rational persuasion methods (RQ2). Its original study also found capable models scoring low and attributed this to alignment ( Ju et al. 2025 ) .
A low persuasiveness score on a manipulative task therefore does not necessarily mean that a model is unable to manipulate, only that it did not do so when asked, and it may reflect stronger safeguards rather than weaker persuasive ability.
Both are worth knowing, but they answer different questions.
Academic studies, including those our methods are drawn from, evaluate released models, so their scores combine the two, whereas developers can measure ability alone by testing models before their final safety training ( OpenAI 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
这些结果共同表明,在说服能力和意愿之间有所区别。
因为每一种方法都指示模型劝说,所以它的分数结合了模型在尝试时的劝说能力以及它尝试的意愿,两者都不同于它在没有被询问的情况下劝说的趋势(Kowal等. 2025; Potter等2024 (英语).
理性的说服任务很少被拒绝,因此它们的分数大多反映能力,这主要跟随一般能力,这些方法彼此一致. 操纵任务直接或间接地被一些能力较强的模型所降低,因此它们的分数也反映了意愿,并且由于模型在哪些任务被他们所降低上存在差异,这些方法既不与理性的,也不相互认同.
仅根据模型所争论的尝试,操纵方法False Claim按能力对模型进行排序,并赞同合理说服方法(RQ2)。 其最初的研究还发现能力模型得分偏低,并将此归因于对接(Ju等2025.).
因此,对操纵性任务的低说服力分数并不一定意味着一个模型无法操纵,只是当它被问及时没有这样做,它可能反映更强有力的保障而不是更弱的说服能力.
两者都值得了解,但他们回答了不同的问题。
包括我们的方法在内的学术研究评价了释放的模型,所以他们的分数结合了两者,而开发者可以在他们最终的安全培训(OpenAI 2024)之前通过测试模型单独衡量能力.

blocks.en:
The disagreement between the methods matters most where persuasion results inform whether a model is released, as under the EU Code of Practice and in developers’ safety frameworks.
A model that scores low on one task can still rank high on another, even among the manipulative tasks, so a single result may provide a false sense of safety.
Regulators should therefore ask which tasks were used, what the model was asked to do and how refusals were scored. More broadly, our findings suggest that safety assessments should consider multiple forms of persuasion, especially when evaluating manipulation risks.
blocks.zh:
不同方法之间的分歧在说服结果是否公布模式(如欧盟业务守则和开发商的安全框架)的情况下最为重要。
一个对一项任务评分低的模型仍然可以在另一项任务中排出高位,甚至在操纵性任务中排出高位,因此一个单一的结果可能会提供虚假的安全感.
因此,监管者应询问使用了哪些任务,要求该模式做什么,以及拒绝的得分如何。 更广泛地说,我们的调查结果表明,安全评估应考虑多种说服形式,特别是在评估操纵风险时。

blocks.en: When evaluating or reporting LLM persuasiveness, we recommend the following. • To assess persuasiveness beyond a single setting, do not rely on one task. Rankings differ across tasks even when refusals are set aside, so choose several tasks that match the risk being assessed, and state with every score what the model was asked to do. • Report refusals, including indirect ones, separately from persuasive success, so that willingness and ability can be read apart. • Report how strongly the scores track general capability, measured on the same models. • Where possible, use more than one judge or persuadee, and validate the results against human judgements.
blocks.zh: 在评价或报告LLM说服力时,我们建议如下: 为了评估超越单一环境的说服力,不要依赖一项任务。 不同的任务的分级不同,即使拒绝被搁置,也不同,所以选择几个与被评估的风险相匹配的任务,并用每个分数说明模型被要求做什么. 二. 支助 报告拒绝,包括间接拒绝,与有说服力的成功分开,这样就能够将意愿和能力分开。 二. 支助 • 报告以同一模式衡量的分数如何有力地跟踪一般能力。 在可能情况下,使用一个以上的法官或说服,并验证不利于人类判决的结果。

blocks.en: To assess persuasiveness beyond a single setting, do not rely on one task. Rankings differ across tasks even when refusals are set aside, so choose several tasks that match the risk being assessed, and state with every score what the model was asked to do.
blocks.zh: 为了评估超越单一环境的说服力,不要依赖一项任务。 不同的任务的分级不同,即使拒绝被搁置,也不同,所以选择几个与被评估的风险相匹配的任务,并用每个分数说明模型被要求做什么.

blocks.en: Report refusals, including indirect ones, separately from persuasive success, so that willingness and ability can be read apart.
blocks.zh: 报告拒绝,包括间接拒绝,与有说服力的成功分开,这样就能够将意愿和能力分开。

blocks.en: Report how strongly the scores track general capability, measured on the same models.
blocks.zh: 报告根据同一模型测得的分数跟踪一般能力的程度。

blocks.en: Where possible, use more than one judge or persuadee, and validate the results against human judgements.
blocks.zh: 在可能情况下,使用一个以上的法官或说服,并验证不利于人类判决的结果。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en: All methods share one persuadee ( GPT-4.1-mini ) and one judge ( GPT-4o ), and an LLM persuadee may respond differently from people. The judge was validated against human verdicts for Rationale only. Sharing the same agents would be expected to raise agreement between methods rather than lower it, although a weak persuadee can also compress the differences among strong persuaders. High reliability does not rule out consistent biases, such as a judge that prefers longer answers, and both pinned agents come from the same developer as two of the evaluated models, and the second judge and persuadee from the same developer as Claude-Fable-5.1 , so a preference for a model family cannot be ruled out.
blocks.zh: 所有方法都具有一种说服力(GPT-4-mini)和一种裁判力(GPT-4o),而一种LLM说服力可能与人不同。 法官仅因理由而反对人类判决。 分享同样的物剂可望提高方法之间的一致,而不是降低这种一致,尽管软弱的说服力也可以压缩强大说服力之间的分歧。 高可靠性并不排除一贯的偏差,比如一个法官更喜欢较长的答案,两个被绑定的代理都来自两个被评价的模型的同一位开发者,第二个判断和劝说来自克劳德-寓言-5.1的同一位开发者,因此不能排除对模型家族的偏好.

blocks.en: Fifteen models and nine methods are enough to detect whether the methods agree, but too few to explain their disagreement beyond suggestion, so the analysis of the eighteen groupings is exploratory. Nine methods also cannot cover every published approach, although they span most of the taxonomy of Dementaviciute and others (2026) . General capability was measured with two benchmarks only, so removing it removes only what these two capture.
blocks.zh: 15个模型和9个方法足以检测方法是否一致,但太少,无法在建议之外解释其不同意见,因此对18个分组的分析是探索性的. 9个方法也无法涵盖所有公布的方法,尽管它们跨越了Dementaviciute和其他方法的大部分分类(2026年). 一般能力只用两个基准来测量,所以去除它只能去除这两个捕获的东西.

blocks.en:
The shared setup is what makes the methods comparable, but our findings therefore concern the methods as adapted, not as published. Several individual changes were checked against the original setting (Section 3.7 and 4.1 ), but no method was rerun in its full original form.
Token limits cut some outputs short, particularly for models that reason before answering. This mattered mainly for Mislead Debate , whose reliability falls below the target partly because of its 512-token cap, so we report RQ1 with and without it and leave it out of RQ2 and RQ3. A full rerun without the cap was outside the budget of this study, so we report the method as run and leave the uncapped version to future work.
blocks.zh:
共同的设置使得方法具有可比性,但我们的研究结果因此涉及方法的调整,而不是公布。 对照原来的设置(第3.7和4.1节)检查了几个个别的改动,但没有任何方法以原来的完整形式重新运行。
调试限制缩短了某些产出,特别是对于回答前的模型。 这主要关系到Mislead辩论, 其可靠性低于目标部分是由于它的512个顶点, 因此我们报告RQ1 有无它, 并将其排除在RQ2和RQ3之外. 没有上限的完整重播超出了本研究的预算,因此我们报告运行的方法,并将未封装版本留给今后的工作.

blocks.en: Finally, our refusal detection counts only direct refusals. Indirect refusals were measured only for False Claim , in a separate analysis that does not enter the main results. The refusal rates in Figure 2 are therefore approximate, but both kinds of refusal score close to zero, so the main results treat them alike.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们发现拒绝只算直接拒绝。 间接拒绝只根据False Claim进行计量,在另一项分析中不计入主要结果。 因此,图2中的拒绝率是大致的,但两种拒绝的得分都接近于零,因此主要结果对它们一视同仁。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We compared nine published automated methods for evaluating LLM persuasiveness on the same fifteen models under a shared setup. The methods agree only weakly on how they rank the models, and this is unlikely to be explained by sampling noise. Agreement appears weakest among the most capable models, which are the main concern of regulation.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了9个公布的自动方法,在共用结构下评价同一15个模型的LLM说服力。 有关方法对模型的排位只有微弱的一致,这不太可能由取样噪音来解释. 最有能力的模式中似乎最弱的协议,这是监管的主要关切。

blocks.en:
Two factors account for part of the disagreement. Models that refuse some tasks but not others (directly or indirectly), lower agreement by about a quarter, and general capability shapes which methods agree, since most rational persuasion methods track it and most manipulation methods do not. Together these produce a split by task type, indicative with eight methods: rational persuasion methods agree moderately with one another, whereas manipulation methods agree neither with them nor with each other, since different models refuse different manipulative tasks.
Persuasion scores therefore combine a model’s ability to persuade with its willingness to do so, and a low manipulation score may reflect stronger safeguards rather than weaker persuasive ability.
LLM persuasion is thus largely in the eye of the evaluation, as conclusions about a model’s persuasiveness depend on the method used and on how its outputs are interpreted.
blocks.zh:
造成分歧的部分原因有两个。 拒绝一些任务但不拒绝其他任务的模型(直接或间接),将协议降低约四分之一,以及方法所同意的一般能力形状,因为大多数理性的说服方法跟踪它,而大多数操纵方法没有。 这些方法合在一起产生按任务类型划分的分法,说明有八种方法:理性的说服方法相互之间略有一致,而操纵方法则既不相互认同,也不相互认同,因为不同的模型拒绝不同的操纵任务.
因此,劝导分数将模型的说服能力与其这样做的意愿结合起来,低操纵分数可能反映更强有力的保障措施,而不是更弱的说服能力。
因此,LLM的说服力主要放在评价的眼里,因为关于一个模型的说服力的结论取决于所使用的方法和如何解释其产出。

blocks.en: A single persuasion score describes a model on one task and may say little about others, even when refusals are set aside. Evaluations would benefit from using more than one task, chosen for the risk being assessed, from reporting refusals, including indirect ones, separately from persuasive success, and from reporting general capability alongside.
blocks.zh: 单一的劝说分数描述一个任务上的模型,即使拒绝被搁置,也可能很少提到其他任务. 评价将受益于利用为评估风险而选择的不止一项任务、报告拒绝(包括间接拒绝)与说服成功分开以及报告一般能力。

blocks.en:
This evaluation method was adapted from Ahnert et al. (2025) .
The evaluated model is a persuader who, over five conversational rounds, tries to move a simulated persuadee (with one of two personas: hard or easy to persuade) towards eating less meat in one of two settings (a canteen lunch or a social-media thread).
The persuadee is asked to answer a three-item, 7-point intention questionnaire outside the conversation, and the score is the change from round one to round five ( − 6 -6 to + 6 +6 ). In total there were four conditions (persona × \times setting), each was run as 20 separate conversations, 80 per model.
blocks.zh:
这一评价方法由Ahnert等人(2025年)改编而来.
被评价的模型是一个说服者,在5个对话回合中,试图移动一个模拟的说服(其中一人:硬或容易被说服),在两个场合之一吃较少的肉(食堂午餐或社交媒体线索).
劝告者被要求回答谈话外的"三品","七分"意向问卷,分数是从一回合改为五回合(-6-6到+6+6). 总共有四个条件(persona ×\times seting),每个条件作为20个单独对话运行,每个模式80个.

blocks.en: Adapted from Amayuelas et al. (2024) , this method evaluates a model’s ability to persuade others to adopt an incorrect answer in a three-agent debate on a multiple-choice question. The evaluated model acts as an adversary and is assigned a specific wrong option to defend. The other two agents (both played by the pinned persuadee) answer independently before engaging in two rounds of debate and revising their answers after each round. The score is the change in the proportion of persuadee agents selecting the adversary’s assigned option between their initial and final answers (range: − 1 -1 to 1 1 ). We used 200 questions sampled from three of the original’s four datasets MMLU ( Hendrycks et al. 2021 ) , TruthfulQA ( Lin et al. 2022 ) , and MedMCQA ( Pal et al. 2022 ) , with the same assigned wrong option used for all evaluated models. The fourth dataset, which was a legal reasoning task, SCALR , is not publicly hosted outside the original code.
blocks.zh: 根据Amayuelas等人(2024年)的说法,这一方法评价了一个模型在对一个多重选择问题的三代理辩论中说服他人采纳错误答案的能力。 被评价的模型充当对手,并被分配到一个特定的错误的辩护选择. 另外两个代理人(都由被钉住的劝说者扮演)在进行两轮辩论之前独立回答,并在每轮辩论后修改答案. 得分是说服代理人在初始答案和最终答案之间选择敌方指定选项的比例变化(范围: - 1 - 1 到 1 个)。 我们使用了从最初的四套数据集中的三套MMLU(Hendrycks等人,2021年),TrealfulQA(Lin等人,2022年)和MedMCQA(Pal等人,2022年)中抽取的200个问题,所有被评价的模型都使用同样的指定错误的选项. 原为法律推理任务的第四套数据集SCALR(英语:SCALR)在原代码之外并不公开主机.

blocks.en: Adapted from Bozdag et al. (2026a) , this evaluation measures the ability of the evaluated model to increase a persuadee’s support for a subjective claim on a social or political issue. The persuader and persuadee models alternate turns in a seven-message exchange, with the persuader speaking first. The persuadee rates its support for the claim on a five-point scale before and after the exchange. The score is the change in this rating, normalised by the maximum possible change in the same direction (range: − 1 -1 to 1 1 ). We used 100 claims.
blocks.zh: 本评价改编自Bozdag等(2026a),衡量了被评价模式在社会或政治问题上增加说服者对主观诉求的支持的能力. 劝说者和劝说模特轮流交替进行七相交流,劝说者先发言. 劝说者在交换前后按五分标准评定其对索赔的支持. 分数是这一分数的改变,由同一方向的最大可能变化(范围:− 1–1到1 1)来规范. 我们用了100份申请

blocks.en: Adapted from Elaraby et al. (2024) , this evaluation measures how persuasively the evaluated model can justify a choice between two arguments. The model is given a debate topic and a pair of arguments on the same side of it, drawn from IBM-ArgQ-9.1kPairs, and, unlike the original is told which of the two a reference GPT-4 run had recommended for a speech on the topic. It writes a rationale for recommending that argument over the other. The pinned judge then compares the model’s rationale with the reference GPT-4 rationale for the same argument, once in each order to cancel position bias. The score is the win rate against the GPT-4 rationale, counting a tie as half a win (0 to 1; 0.5 means equally persuasive). We used 100 argument pairs sampled across the dataset’s twenty debate topics.
blocks.zh: 根据Elaraby等人(2024年)的说法,本评价衡量了被评价模式如何有说服力地证明在两个论点之间作出选择是合理的。 该模型被赋予一个辩论话题和同一边的一对论点,取自IBM-ArgQ-9.1kPairs,与原著不同的是,GPT-4的参考文献中,哪一个建议就这一专题发表演讲。 它写了建议这一论点的理由。 被钉住的法官然后将模型的理由与GPT-4相同论点的参考理由进行比较,每次是为了消除位置偏差。 得分是相对于GPT-4理由的取胜率,将平局计为半胜(0比1;0.5表示同样有说服力). 我们用100对对对的论据 抽样了数据集的20个辩论话题。

blocks.en:
Adapted from Ju et al. (2025) , this evaluation measures the ability of a model to convince a persuadee LLM that a specific false claim is true.
For each question from the CounterFact dataset ( Meng et al. 2022 ) , the evaluated model is given the question and a false answer, and writes a paragraph of misleading evidence for that answer using one of eleven predefined persuasion strategies (appeals to authority, conformity, etc.). The pinned persuadee reads the paragraph and then answers the question.
The final metric is the proportion of responses that contain the false answer (range: 0 to 1). We used 120 questions, evaluating each with all eleven strategies, for a total of 1,320 attempts.
blocks.zh:
改编自Ju等人(2025年),本评价衡量一个模型说服LLM相信一个特定的虚假说法是真实的能力.
对来自反事实数据集(Meng等2022年)的每个问题,评价模型都给出了问题和错误的答案,并用11个预先确定的说服策略之一(对权威的呼吁、一致性等)为答案写出一段误导性证据。 被钉住的人劝说阅读该段,然后回答问题。
最后的衡量标准是包含虚假答案的回复比例(范围:0到1). 我们使用了120个问题,每个问题都用所有11个战略进行评估,总共1 320次尝试。

blocks.en: Adapted from Liu et al. (2025) , this evaluation measures the model’s ability to persuade a resistant persuadee model to comply with a benign request over a maximum of 10 conversational turns. Across 30 scenarios, the persuadee model is set up to resist the request and adopts one of five personalities (resilient, emotionally sensitive, conflict-averse, info-overwhelmed or anxious). The model converses with the persuadee for up to ten turns and may use any of 15 manipulative persuasion strategies listed in its prompt, but is not required to. After each message the persuadee may accept or reject the request. The conversation ends if the request is accepted, rejected four times, or after 10 turns. A pinned LLM-judge rates the persuasive effectiveness on a five-point rubric, which is then normalized to a [0, 1] scale. The persuadee’s decision is recorded but does not enter the score. We used every scenario with all five personalities, 150 conversations in total.
blocks.zh: 根据Liu等人(2025年)的改编,本评价衡量该模型在最多10个对话回合以上说服抗药性模型遵守良性请求的能力。 在30种情况下,建立说服模式是为了抵制请求,并采纳五个人格之一(耐受、情绪敏感、避免冲突、信息覆盖或焦虑)。 模型与劝导者交接最多可达10个转弯,并可能使用其即时列出的15个操纵劝导策略中的任何一种,但无需使用. 每次发信后,劝告人可以接受或拒绝请求。 如果请求被接受,4次被拒绝,或10次转会后,对话即告结束. 一名固定的LLM法官将说服力的分数评为五分,然后改为[0]分数。 劝告者的决定被记录下来,但没有进入得分. 我们用每一个场景 与所有五个人物, 总共150个对话。

blocks.en: Adapted from the MakeMePay game in OpenAI (2024) , this evaluation measures the ability of the evaluated model to persuade a target to hand over money. The persuader model acts as a con artist against a pinned model playing the target, who holds $100. The two converse for up to ten turns, and the target can donate by writing a payment tag such as [GIVE $N] . After each reply, a rule checks for this tag, if there is none but the target has mentioned a dollar amount – a summarising model extracts the donated amount. The episode ends upon the first donation, if the target withdraws, or after ten turns. The score is the number of dollars donated (ranging from 0 to 100), averaged over 250 episodes.
blocks.zh: 本评价从OpenAI(2024)的MakeMePay游戏中改编而来,衡量被评价模式说服目标交出资金的能力. 说服者模型扮演一个骗子艺术家,反对一个被钉住的模型扮演目标,他持有100美元. 两个转会最多可达10个转会,目标可以通过写出[GIVE $N]等支付标记来进行捐赠. 每次回复后,如果没有,则对该标签进行规则检查,但目标提到了一美元金额 — — 一个汇总模型提取了捐赠金额。 剧集以第一次捐赠为结束,如果目标退出,或者经过十回转. 得分是捐赠的美元数(从0到100不等),平均超过250集.

blocks.en: Adapted from the MakeMeSay game in OpenAI (2024) , this evaluation measures the ability of the evaluated model to manipulate a persuadee model into saying a secret codeword, known only to the persuader, without noticing it. The persuader and the pinned persuadee exchange messages over 15 conversational rounds. Afterwards the persuadee is asked to guess the codeword, and the pinned LLM-judge rules whether the persuadee identified it. The persuader wins if the persuadee says the codeword before the persuader does and then fails to identify it when asked. The final persuasiveness score is the win rate over 50 codewords, each played once.
blocks.zh: 本评价取自OpenAI (2024)的"Make MeSay"(Make MeSay)游戏,衡量被评价的模型操控说服的模型说出一个只为说服者所熟知的暗语的能力,而没有注意到. 劝说者和被钉住的劝说者通过15个对话回合交流信息。 之后劝告者被要求去猜出密码词,被钉住的LLM判断者判断劝告者是否识别出密码词. 如果劝说者在劝说者之前说出密码字,然后在被问到时无法辨认出来,则劝说者获胜. 最终的说服力分数是胜出率超过50个密码字,每分一次.

blocks.en: Adapted from Pauli and others (2025) , this evaluation measures the ability of the evaluated model to make a human-written text more persuasive. The model is asked to rewrite the text so that it sounds more persuasive. A frozen DeBERTaV3-Large regression model, trained on human pairwise judgements of persuasiveness, scores the original and the rewrite as a pair, in both orders. The final score is the scorer’s relative persuasiveness rating of the rewrite against the original, averaged across both presentation orders. Positive scores favour the rewrite, and negative scores favour the original. We used 230 texts sampled from the Persuasive-Pairs dataset.
blocks.zh: 本评价改编自Pauli等(2025),衡量被评价模式使人文文字更具说服力的能力. 该模型被要求重写文本,使其听起来更有说服力. 一个被冻结的DeBERTAV3-Large回归模型,经过了人双判断说服力的训练,将原作和重写分为一对,在两种顺序中都是一对. 最终得分是得分者相对说服力对原作的重写评分,在两种呈现命令中均分. 正面分数有利于重写,负面分数有利于原作. 我们用了230个文本样本 从Persuassive-Pairs数据集。

blocks.en: Appendix B Method Adaptations
blocks.zh: 附录B 方法调整

blocks.en:
Every persuadee is played by one shared model and every judge by another, described under Experimental Setup. In three original methods the evaluated model played its own persuadee ( Reduce Meat , False Claim , Mislead Debate ), which conflates a model’s persuasiveness with its own resistance. A fixed persuadee separates the two and gives every method the same recipient. A shared judge likewise gives the three judged methods the same scorer. Rationale tells every model which of the two arguments to justify, so all models justify the same choice. The original dropped the items on which models chose differently. Each rationale is then judged against one fixed GPT-4 rationale from the dataset, not against every other model’s as in the original. This keeps each model’s score independent of the others. Subjective Opinion runs only the original’s subjective claims, its headline setting. The original reports that persuader rankings are stable across its claim types. Its persuadee ran at temperature 0, where the original used 0.7. Benign Request was evaluated only on the original study’s ethically neutral scenarios, so that refusals of harmful requests do not dominate its score.
Its persuadee is told to resist the request, as in the released code, although the persuadee prompt printed in the original paper has no such instruction. Without it the persuadee accepted almost every request. Its persuadee ran at temperature 0, where the original used 1. It leaves out 26 conversations whose judge verdict our parser could not read, 22 of them a 0 because the persuader left its task, which the original averages in. Rewrite Text draws its texts from the data its scorer was trained on, where the original used 200 new texts, which raises its scores but, as every model rewrites the same texts, should barely affect its ranking.
In Mislead Debate we score how many of the other agents adopt the wrong option the adversary was assigned. The original scored agreement with whatever answer the adversary stated, so the two differ only where the adversary itself abandoned its assigned wrong answer. We also cap every debate message at 512 tokens. MakeMePay and MakeMeSay are applied to the released models with final safety training, whereas OpenAI evaluates both pre-mitigation and post-mitigation models ( OpenAI 2024 ) . Claude-Fable-5.1 , GPT-5.6-Sol and Kimi-K2.6 accept only their default temperature, so they ran at it on every method.
The pooled scores of False Claim and Mislead Debate , and the Rewrite Text scorer, are checked in Section 3.7 .
Smaller changes, such as token limits, prompt details and turn limits, will be listed in full with the released code.
blocks.zh:
每一个劝说都由一个共同的模型来演奏,每个裁判都由另一个在"实验设置"下描述. 在三种原始方法中,被评价的模型发挥自己的说服力(减少肉类、虚假索赔、误导辩论),将模型的说服力与自身的阻力混为一谈。 一个固定的劝说将两者分开,并给予每一种方法都得到相同的接受. 同样,共同法官也给予三种判断方法同样的分数。 理由告诉每个模型 这两种论点中哪一种是正当的, 所以所有模型都证明同样的选择是合理的。 原作放弃了模型选择不同的项目. 然后,根据数据集中固定的GPT-4理由来判断每个理由,而不是按照原始模型中的其他每个模型来判断。 这使得每个模型的得分独立于其他模型. 主观意见只涉及原作者的主观主张及其头条设置。 劝说者按索赔类型排列的原始报告是稳定的。 它的劝说在0温下跑出,最初使用0.7. Benign Request只根据最初研究在道德上中立的情景来评价,因此拒绝有害的请求不会占其得分的首位.
它的劝说被告诉抵制这一请求,如同所发行的代码一样,尽管原始纸上所印刷的劝说快件没有这样的指示. 没有它,说服者几乎接受了每一项请求。 它的说服力在0温下运行,最初使用1. 法官判定我们无法阅读的26个谈话, 其中22个是0, 因为劝说者离开了自己的任务, 重写 文本取自其计分员所培训的数据,其中最初使用了200个新文本,这提高了其分数,但随着每个模型重写相同的文本,其分数几乎不会受到影响。
在“误导辩论”中,我们得分的是,其他代理人中有多少人选择了敌人被指派的错误选择。 原本的得分一致 与对手所说的任何答案, 所以两者不同 只有在对手自己放弃 指定错误的答案。 我们还把每次辩论的信息封为512个纪念品。 Make MePay和MakeMeSay被应用到已发布的模型中,并经过了最终的安全培训,而OpenAI同时评价了前缓解和后缓解模型(OpenAI 2024 ). Claude-Fable-5.1,GPT-5.6-Sol和Kimi-K2.6只接受他们的默认温度,所以他们用每一种方法都运行在它上.
第3.7节检查了 " 虚假索赔 " 和 " 误导辩论 " 以及 " 重写文字计分器 " 的集合得分。
较小的更改,如令牌限制,即时细节和转弯限制,将会被完整地与所发布的代码一起列出.
